name: Dragon's Hoard
description: An epic strategy board game where players compete to amass the greatest treasure hoard. Features stunning dragon miniatures and over 200 unique token pieces. Perfect for 2-5 players with games lasting 60-90 minutes.

name: Realm of Shadows
description: A cooperative dungeon-crawling board game with procedurally generated maps. Each playthrough is unique with randomized encounters and loot tokens. Supports 1-4 players.

name: Merchant's Guild
description: A economic strategy game where players build trade empires using resource tokens. Negotiate, trade, and outwit your opponents in this deep euro-style game. 3-6 players.

name: Titan's Arena
description: Fast-paced arena combat board game with detailed fighter tokens. Choose your champion and battle through increasingly dangerous rounds. Quick 30-minute games for 2-4 players.

name: Arcane Legends TCG - Starter Deck
description: Begin your journey into the Arcane Legends Trading Card Game. This starter deck includes 60 cards, a rulebook, and a set of life counter tokens. Perfect for beginners.

name: Arcane Legends TCG - Booster Box
description: 36 booster packs of the latest Arcane Legends expansion 'Ethereal Storm'. Each pack contains 15 cards with guaranteed rare or higher. Chase mythic holographic cards!

name: Cipher - The Deduction Card Game
description: A clever deduction card game where players decode secret messages using numbered cipher tokens. Compact and travel-friendly. 2-6 players, 20-minute rounds.

name: Shadow Syndicate
description: A social deduction card game of hidden roles and secret agendas. Use bluff tokens to mislead your opponents. Perfect party game for 5-10 players.

name: Elven Warband - Miniature Set
description: A beautifully sculpted set of 12 elven warrior miniatures. Includes archers, swordsmen, mages, and a legendary hero figure. Unpainted, 28mm scale.

name: Undead Legion - Miniature Set
description: Raise your army with 15 undead miniatures including skeletons, zombies, a necromancer, and a bone dragon. Highly detailed sculpts in 28mm scale.

name: Sci-Fi Mech Squad
description: Four highly detailed mech miniatures for sci-fi tabletop games. Each mech features modular weapon loadouts. Pre-assembled, 32mm scale.

name: Terrain Building Kit - Fantasy Village
description: Complete terrain kit to build a fantasy village for your tabletop games. Includes buildings, fences, trees, and scatter terrain. Pre-colored, snap-fit assembly.

name: Premium Metal Dice Set - Nebula
description: A stunning 7-piece metal dice set with swirling nebula purple and cosmic blue finish. Includes D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, and percentile die. Comes in a velvet-lined case.

name: Gemstone Dice Set - Amethyst
description: Hand-carved from genuine amethyst crystal. Each die is unique with natural color variations. 7-piece RPG set in a wooden display box.

name: Resource Token Set - Deluxe
description: 150 premium resource tokens for board and card games. Includes gold coins, crystal gems, wooden cubes, and metal ingots. Compatible with most popular games.

name: Life Counter Tokens - Neon Set
description: 40 glow-in-the-dark life counter tokens in 4 neon colors. Stackable design with engraved numbers. Perfect for TCG and tabletop RPGs.

name: Condition Marker Ring Set
description: Color-coded condition marker rings for miniature bases. 60 rings in 12 colors for tracking buffs, debuffs, and status effects during gameplay.

name: Premium Card Sleeves - Holographic
description: Pack of 100 holographic-back card sleeves. Standard card size (63.5 x 88mm). Premium thickness with anti-glare front. Acid-free protection.

name: Game Master Screen - Deluxe
description: A premium 4-panel GM screen with magnetic panels and built-in initiative tracker. Landscape format with customizable inserts. Faux leather finish.

name: Dice Tower - Crystal Spire
description: An acrylic dice tower shaped like a crystal spire. LED-lit base changes color on impact. Satisfying rolling experience with built-in tray.

name: Battle Mat - Hex Grid
description: Double-sided neoprene battle mat (24x36 inches). Hex grid on one side, square grid on the other. Wet-erase compatible. Non-slip rubber base.

name: Card Binder - Collector's Edition
description: Premium 360-card binder with side-loading pockets. Padded cover with embossed dragon design. Includes 20 removable 9-pocket pages.

name: Miniature Paint Set - Pro
description: Professional-grade acrylic paint set with 24 colors specifically formulated for miniature painting. Includes 3 brushes and a wet palette.

name: Arcane Legends TCG - Playmat
description: Official Arcane Legends TCG playmat with printed card zones. High-quality fabric surface with stitched edges. Full art illustration by renowned fantasy artist.
